title: Hash Brown Medley
description: A simple, elegant hash brown dish with a mediterranean twist, featuring crispy almond slivers.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, combine diced potatoes, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
3. Add the beaten egg to the bowl and mix until the potato mixture is well coated.
4. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the potato mixture and cook until the bottom is crispy.
5. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
6. While the hash browns are baking, toast the sliced almonds in a small skillet over medium heat until crispy.
7. Remove the hash browns from the oven and top with toasted almond slivers.
